extraction.name: Geometry3K
extraction.description: A large-scale benchmark consisting of 3,002 geometry problems with dense annotation in formal language.
extraction.creator: Pan Lu, Ran Gong, Shibiao Jiang, Liang Qiu, Siyuan Huang, Xiaodan Liang, Song-Chun Zhu
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Groups of well-trained annotators with undergraduate degrees manually collect each problem with its problem text, geometry diagram, four candidate choices, and correct answer.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Two popular textbooks for high school students across grades 6-12 by two online digital libraries (McGraw-Hill, Geometryonline).
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Annotators manually collected each problem with its text, diagram, choices, and answer. The data was further labeled with the corresponding problem goal and geometry shapes, and densely annotated with formal language descriptions.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset and models may inspire research in symbolic reasoning and interpretable models, and facilitate education.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Diagram parsing tends to fail with ambiguous annotations or multiple primitives. The text parser struggles with nested expressions and uncertain references. The symbolic solver cannot solve complex problems with combined shapes and shaded areas.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training and evaluating geometry problem parsers and solvers.
